title: EEZ Settlement
description: Settlement triggers, submission outcomes and durations, and cross-chain request counts.

panels.title: Latest settled commitment
panels.description: Time since the L1 commitment used by the latest settlement evaluation. Before the first settlement, this starts at rollup registration. Blank while the policy is being reevaluated after a chain update.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_settlement_anchor_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

(reth_eez_composer_settlement_anchor_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"} >= 0) * 1000 and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

(reth_eez_composer_settlement_anchor_l1_block{job="eez-composer-reth"} >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Latest cross-chain completion
panels.description: Elapsed time and local timestamp when Composer confirmed the latest retained cross-chain completion. The linked L1 block is the chain state checked during reconciliation; the transaction may have been included in an earlier block. Blank before an observed completion or after its block is reverted.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_last_completion_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

(reth_eez_composer_queue_last_completion_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"} >= 0) * 1000 and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

(reth_eez_composer_queue_last_completion_l1_block{job="eez-composer-reth"} >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Progress toward block settlement trigger
panels.description: Unsettled L2 blocks as a percentage of the configured block threshold, including empty blocks. At 100% this trigger is due. Cross-chain activity and other triggers can settle earlier.

targets.expr: (reth_eez_composer_settlement_unsettled_blocks{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)) / on(job, instance, rollup_id) (reth_eez_composer_settlement_block_threshold{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)) * 100

panels.title: Settlement trigger reasons
panels.description: Reasons active at the latest settlement evaluation (1 = active, 0 = inactive): block limit, ordinary L2 activity, interval elapsed, executable cross-chain requests, blob fullness, remaining batch work, or window limit. Several reasons can apply together. Gaps occur while that evaluation is unavailable after a chain update.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_settlement_trigger{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Current unresolved submission (sampled)
panels.description: State of the oldest unresolved submission. None means no attempt is awaiting reconciliation. Included means its L1 receipt was found; cross-chain completions are counted separately below. Brief states can occur between scrapes; the submission event counters retain their outcomes.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Submission events since restart
panels.description: Number of prepared, dispatched, included, excluded, uncertain, and preflight-failed attempts since Composer started. A retry adds another attempt. Included counts L1 receipts.

panels.title: Latest submission event times
panels.description: Latest local time each submission event occurred. Prepared starts after proving; dispatched starts the network request; included is when the receipt was observed. Event types with no occurrence are omitted.

panels.title: Submission timings
panels.description: Elapsed seconds for the latest attempt at each stage. Prepared-to-dispatch includes waiting and final pricing after proving. Dispatch-to-outcome includes the network request and receipt lookup. A stage appears after its first measurement.

panels.title: Submission exclusions since restart
panels.description: Failed submission attempts by reason since Composer started: excluded by the submission path, skipped L1 slot, missed submission window, or changed target. The submitter does not distinguish auction loss from builder or relay rejection.

panels.title: Cross-chain requests in latest submitted Sync attempt
panels.description: Inbound and outbound user requests selected for the latest Sync submission attempt. System transactions are excluded; retries count again and anchor-only attempts contain zero. The value stays unchanged until the next attempt. Exact block/count pairs are in the eez.composer.submission.sync_requests log event.

panels.title: Latest submitted Sync L2 block
panels.description: L2 block selected for the latest Sync submission attempt. Use the adjacent graph for its inbound/outbound request counts; this height is recorded before inclusion.

panels.title: Canonical cross-chain completion observations
panels.description: Cross-chain user effects confirmed by canonical reconciliation since Composer started, split by direction. Repeated checks do not increase the counter. An effect reverted and later confirmed again counts again.
